# Getting started

When you first sign up, Aevum gives you a short, friendly on-ramp so you're never
staring at an empty app wondering where to begin. It's a guided path — and every part of
it is **optional**. You can follow it, skip it, or come back to it later.

## Setting things up

The first time you land, a quick setup opens on its own. It walks you through three
small things:

- **Your name** — so the app can greet you.
- **Securing your account** — set up account recovery and, if you like, two-step
  sign-in. This one's optional.
- **Region & currency** — confirm where you are and which currency you think in. Also
  optional.

You can move through it a step at a time, skip any optional step, or close it entirely
and head straight to your dashboard. And it only ever nudges you **once** — if you close
it and come back tomorrow, it won't pop up again and trap you. It's a helping hand, not a
gate.

## Finding your feet

Once you're set up, a short **Getting Started** checklist helps you take the first real
steps:

- **Add an account** — tell Aevum about a bank account or wallet.
- **Import a statement** — bring in real transactions from a PDF statement.
- **Take the tour** — a guided walkthrough of the app (more below).
- **Try sample data** — explore with realistic made-up data before committing your own.

The nice part: the checklist watches what you actually do. Add an account and that item
quietly checks itself off — there's no separate "mark as done" busywork. It reflects
where you really are, so it always tells you the truth.

You can reach this checklist any time from the **Help** page, so there's no rush to
finish it in one sitting.

## Exploring with sample data

Not ready to add your own numbers yet? You can fill Aevum with **realistic sample data**
and click around freely — see how budgets, the tax tracker, and your dashboard come to
life — all without touching anything real. While sample data is active, a gentle banner
reminds you the numbers aren't yours, so you're never confused about what you're looking
at. When you're done, clearing it out is a single step.

## Taking the tour

The guided tour is a short, narrated walk through the "life of a transaction" — from your
dashboard, through your spending and budgets, to the tax tracker and back. It highlights
one thing at a time and moves you across the app as it goes, so you get the shape of the
whole product in a few minutes.

If you stop partway, Aevum remembers where you were and lets you pick up from there. And
so the tour has something to point at, it can quietly set up sample data while it runs and
tidy it away when it finishes — leaving your real data exactly as it was.

## You're always in control

Nothing here is forced. Skip the setup, ignore the checklist, or take the tour on your
third visit instead of your first — Aevum won't badger you. The on-ramp is there when you
want it and out of the way when you don't.
